title.zh: 全国疾病登记处（慢性肾功能衰竭指明实体）公告 2011
title.en: National Registry of Diseases (Specified Entity for Chronic Kidney Failure) Notification 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the National Registry of Diseases (Specified Entity for Chronic Kidney Failure) Notification 2011 and shall come into operation on 1st March 2011.

heading.en: Specified entity for chronic kidney failure

text.en: 2. The National Registry of Diseases Office of the Health Promotion Board established under the Health Promotion Board Act (Cap. 122B) is declared to be a specified entity for the collection of information relating to chronic kidney failure for the purposes of section 24 of the Act.
